author: noel_brandvold
subject: Pizza for 25 kids at a Saturday birthday, recs?
body: My son turns seven this Saturday, and we are doing a backyard party for about twenty five kids. Hollis Brick Oven Pizza is on my list, but I have not called yet. Does anyone know a place that does party trays and a pickup order without a long wait? Sorry this is so long, I tend to overthink these.

comments.author: renata_ocampo
comments.body: Hollis Brick Oven Pizza does party trays for twenty five, and they will set up a pickup window if you call a day ahead. Ask for the party tray sheet when you call.

comments.author: kwame_ofori
comments.body: Hollis Brick Oven Pizza, no contest. Kids eat the crust first and then ask for more crust. You will be the hero of the backyard.

comments.author: owen_pruitt
comments.body: Hollis Brick Oven Pizza for us, every party. Grab the cookies from Marrow & Yeast Bakehouse for dessert too, the kids go crazy for them. Order two dozen for twenty five kids, trust me.

comments.author: gabriel_nunez
comments.body: Gabriel here from the kitchen at Hollis Brick Oven Pizza. We do party trays for twenty five, and we will set up the pickup window for Saturday. Call before noon Friday and we will hold a tray for you.

comments.author: priya_lakhani
comments.body: Thank you all. I will call Hollis Brick Oven Pizza on Monday and tell them the party is Saturday. Noel, good luck with the twenty five kids!

author: sadie_kimbrough
subject: Cake that feeds 40 for my grandmother's 80th?
body: My grandmother turns eighty on the first Saturday in November, and the whole family is coming in from out of state. I am thinking about Marrow & Yeast Bakehouse, but I do not know if they take big orders. Does anyone have a bakery they love for a celebration cake? She likes lemon, if that helps.

comments.author: frances_hollis
comments.body: Marrow & Yeast Bakehouse did my mother's eightieth last spring. They do a lemon cake with real butter cream, and the tiered one feeds forty easily. Congratulations to your grandmother!

comments.author: hanna_lindgren
comments.body: Order at least ten days ahead. Marrow & Yeast Bakehouse books up for holiday weekends. I checked their calendar this week, and the first Saturday in November is already booked, so ask about the next one.

comments.author: greta_oseland
comments.body: Get the sprinkle cookies on the side too, the kids will fight over them. Marrow & Yeast Bakehouse packs them in a box for parties. Pick up a coffee from Tern & Thistle Coffee to go with it.

comments.author: jolene_harkins
comments.body: Jolene here. Does Marrow & Yeast Bakehouse do sheet cakes for the guests too, or only the big ones?

comments.author: renata_ocampo
comments.body: Ask for buttercream without the fondant if your grandmother does not like it. Marrow & Yeast Bakehouse is easy about that, and they will pipe the message from a note you send ahead.

author: jolene_harkins
subject: Marrow & Yeast Bakehouse taking the old storefront in Halsey Crossing?
body: Saw a permit sign taped in the window of the old shoe repair space in the Halsey Crossing plaza. It looks like Marrow & Yeast Bakehouse is opening a second location there. Anyone heard more? I will keep my eyes open and report back.

comments.author: benito_ruiz
comments.body: I walk that route. The permit went up on the door last week, and it is for a change of use on the shoe repair space. Is Marrow & Yeast Bakehouse really the one behind it?

comments.author: hanna_lindgren
comments.body: I checked the county filing this morning. It is a change of use for a bakery with a retail counter, filed under the bakehouse's business name, so it looks right. Quill Plumbing Co. is also listed for the sink hookup.

comments.author: sadie_kimbrough
comments.body: I'm new, is Marrow & Yeast Bakehouse the one with the sourdough? I would love to know before I plan my Saturday.

comments.author: colleen_brandt
comments.body: So excited! Marrow & Yeast Bakehouse is my favorite bakery in the whole ridge, and the bread is the best in town. Pair a loaf with a coffee from Tern & Thistle Coffee. Congratulations to the team!

comments.author: lupe_ochoa
comments.body: Congratulations! I hope the new spot does the Friday loaves the same way the first one does. Marrow & Yeast Bakehouse is the best.

author: bernadette_hughes
subject: Penrose Lane Books clearing the back shelves, half off through Sunday
body: Penrose Lane Books is holding a clearance sale on the back shelves through Sunday, half off everything marked with the orange tag. I stopped in on Thursday, and the staff said they are making room for the new fall stock. Good chance to pick up a few gifts early.

comments.author: frances_hollis
comments.body: I went this morning. Penrose Lane Books had three mysteries and a cookbook for under twenty dollars, and the staff wrapped them for free. Lovely shop.

comments.author: odessa_wright
comments.body: Does the half off at Penrose Lane Books cover hardcovers too, or only paperbacks?

comments.author: bernadette_hughes
comments.body: Hardcovers too, except the signed copies behind the desk. The staff at Penrose Lane Books will show you the orange tags.

comments.author: kofi_mensah
comments.body: Penrose Lane Books is a good Saturday trip. Grab a coffee at Tern & Thistle Coffee on the way, the cinnamon buns are a dangerous thing.

author: marisol_quintero
subject: Hollis Brick Oven Pizza putting in a walk-up window?
body: There is a crew at Hollis Brick Oven Pizza building a small counter facing Tennant Pike, with a sign for walk-up slices. Anyone know when it opens? My twins have been begging for pizza after soccer, and this might be the answer. Quick question, nothing else.

comments.author: kwame_ofori
comments.body: Finally, a place to get a slice after the late game. Hollis Brick Oven Pizza is the best pizza I have had in this county, and that is no joke.

comments.author: tomasz_wojcik
comments.body: Slice prices matter. The last time I was in at Hollis Brick Oven Pizza, slices were four fifty each, so ask before you order.

comments.author: gabriel_nunez
comments.body: Gabriel here from Hollis Brick Oven Pizza. The window opens the first week of November, with slices at lunch and late night. Thanks for the love, Kwame. Quill Plumbing Co. did our sink hookup, and they were quick.

comments.author: lupe_ochoa
comments.body: Wonderful news. Could someone post the walk-up hours here when they are set?

author: gil_fenner
subject: Pruett Hardware & Supply changing hours starting November 1
body: Heads up for the handy folks. Pruett Hardware & Supply posted a sign on the door: starting November 1 they close on Sundays and open at seven on weekdays. The counter staff told me Saturday hours stay the same. Good to know before you plan a weekend project.

comments.author: casimir_lowe
comments.body: Pruett Hardware & Supply has been my hardware store since 1999. The Sunday closure is a hassle, but the counter guys know their stuff and find parts nobody else carries.

comments.author: henrik_dahl
comments.body: Their weekday hours went from eight to six last winter, per the sign on the door. Keep your receipts, I believe the return window changed too.

comments.author: otis_whitfield
comments.body: pruett hardware & supply has the best cut keys in the county, sunday or not. they cut them while you wait

comments.author: nadia_sorokina
comments.body: Pruett Hardware & Supply also rents the wood splitter if you have a pile of logs to deal with before the cold comes. Call ahead on Saturdays.

comments.author: curtis_bell
comments.body: Pruett Hardware & Supply sold me the right extension cord for the generator last week. They asked questions first, which is what you want. Great store.

author: tess_harmon
subject: Gray sectional couch for sale, $150
body: Three piece gray sectional in good shape. One cushion has a small stain on the back, so I priced it low. It measures about 98 inches across the longest run. Pickup in Ember Fields on any weekend, cash only, and bring two people to lift it.

comments.author: ansel_grieco
comments.body: What is the seat depth? Sectionals never fit my living room, and I would like to know before I drive over.

comments.author: tess_harmon
comments.body: The seats are about 22 inches deep. Measure your doorway first, because the sections come apart and fit through most doors.

comments.author: mateo_gallegos
comments.body: I have a truck and can help you move it. Buy me a coffee at Tern & Thistle Coffee after, and we are even.

author: eli_stroud
subject: Kids 20 inch bike, barely used, $40
body: Selling my daughter's 20 inch bike. She outgrew it in one summer. It has a hand brake and a basket, and the tires are good. Cash, pickup anytime after school. Message me if you want a photo, I forgot to take one realy sorry.

comments.author: owen_pruitt
comments.body: Does it have a hand brake? My son is still learning to stop, so that matters a lot to me.

comments.author: eli_stroud
comments.body: Yes hand brake, and the basket too. Its in good shape. Pruett Hardware & Supply can swap the pads for a few bucks if they are worn.

comments.author: kwame_ofori
comments.body: Forty dollars for a bike that size is a steal. Your daughter will be the best dressed kid on the block.

author: harlan_dietz
subject: Two stage snowblower, runs well, $300 or best offer
body: Two stage snowblower, 2014 model, 24 inch clearing width, electric start. It was serviced last fall and runs well. Asking 300 or best offer. Pickup in Larkspur Knoll, and I will help you load it onto a trailer.

comments.author: ivan_kuzmenko
comments.body: What year is the auger shear pin? If it is original, Pruett Hardware & Supply can get you a spare in ten minutes, and it is worth having one in the drawer.

comments.author: harlan_dietz
comments.body: 2014, and the shear pin is new, I replaced it last fall. I will take 275 if you can pick it up this week.

comments.author: lloyd_sutter
comments.body: Hate snow. Would buy it if it started on the first pull.

author: curtis_bell
subject: Free seasoned firewood, you haul. Oak and maple
body: I have about a rick of seasoned oak and maple, split and stacked under a tarp. It is free to anyone who hauls it away. Bring your own truck or trailer, and come by after six on weekdays. I am giving it away because I am downsizing my woodpile, not because the wood is bad.

comments.author: gil_fenner
comments.body: I will take a rick if you have room. Do you have a splitter, or should I bring one? Pruett Hardware & Supply rents them by the day if you do not have one.

comments.author: curtis_bell
comments.body: The splitter is mine, but I am out of gas right now. Bring your own gloves. Keep the stack a few feet from the house and keep an extinguisher in the truck.

comments.author: wendell_pike
comments.body: Check the local code before you stack a woodpile by a fence line. The setback rule is in section nine point four of the property maintenance code, and I looked it up last year.

comments.author: remy_castellano
comments.body: Is this for a fire pit? I have toddlers and I am nervous, so I want to ask the safe way to handle it.

author: kayleigh_drummond
subject: Crib for sale, converts to a toddler bed, $90
body: We are done with the crib. It is a fixed side model that converts to a toddler bed, and the mattress is included. Everything is assembled, and we can take it apart for you. Pickup in Wren Hollow after six, cash only please.

comments.author: priya_lakhani
comments.body: Is it the fixed side style? Drop side cribs are banned now, so make sure before you drive over. Good luck with the sale.

comments.author: kayleigh_drummond
comments.body: Fixed side, bought in 2024 and never used the drop rail. The slats are close together. Asking ninety.

comments.author: remy_castellano
comments.body: Do you deliver to Halsey Crossing? I would be interested if it is not too far.

comments.author: esther_lund
comments.body: Good luck with the sale. I hope the next little one sleeps well in it.

author: ruth_ellery
subject: Wanted: used rear tine tiller, will come get it
body: I am looking for a used rear tine tiller for the back garden plot. Nothing fancy, and I will pay cash. If you have one that runs, or one that needs a carburetor cleaning, please let me know. I will bring a trailer and gloves. Thank you, neighbors.

comments.author: hal_brenneman
comments.body: I have an old rear tine tiller in the garage. It needs a carburetor cleaning and a new spark plug, but it runs. Free if you come get it this month.

comments.author: ruth_ellery
comments.body: Yes please! Could you bring it on Saturday morning? I will have the trailer hitched.

comments.author: gil_fenner
comments.body: Hatch & Hyacinth Garden Center rents a tiller in the spring if you need one sooner than Hal can get it to you. Call the garden desk and ask for the rear tine model.
